svg.aria-label: The IES core class hierarchy, lit in four beats. The subclass edges a person asserted, then the edges the engine derived, then a Lean 4 proof sweeping them, then one forged derivation that the same checker refuses.
svg.text: 139 classes and 401 subclass edges drawn, out of 1083 asserted triples and 265 derived
ASSERTED 144 subclass edges, claimed by a person
CERTIFIED 257 derived, rdfs11 x257, rdfs5 x8, theorem OOCert.certificate_sound
REFUSED one conclusion forged; oo-cert exited 1 and named rdfs11
